2607.29549.title: AMTFV: Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification for LLM Self-Correction
2607.29549.paper_summary: Large language models have demonstrated strong mathematical problem-solving capabilities, yet reliably verifying their candidate answers remains challenging. Existing representative methods mainly revise outputs through natural-language reflection or assist verification by directly generating verification programs; the former may not reliably support exact computation, whereas the latter prematurely couples mathematical modeling with low-level implementation. We propose AMTFV (Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification). By introducing Mathematical Tool Flow (MTF) as an interrupt--execute--resume interface, AMTFV decouples verification modeling from concrete execution and supports exact computation through a mathematical toolbox. Specifically, the verification agent first constructs a verification workflow, encodes the mathematical objects and computational intent requiring reliable execution in an MTF request, and sends it to the mathematical toolbox agent. The latter parses the request, generates executable calls, and dispatches them to the backend for exact computation. Tool outputs then support candidate-answer adjudication, answer revision, and verification-workflow revision. We evaluate AMTFV on five challenging mathematical reasoning datasets with seven model configurations from DeepSeek, GPT, and Gemini. Experimental results show that AMTFV outperforms the representative baselines evaluated in this study overall; under an individual model configuration, it improves average accuracy over the strongest baseline by up to 8.3 percentage points, with larger gains on samples of medium and high verification complexity.
2607.29549.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型已顯示出強大的數學問題解決能力，但可靠地驗證其候選答案仍然具有挑戰性。現有的代表性方法主要通過自然語言反思來修正輸出，或通過直接生成驗證程序來協助驗證；前者可能無法可靠地支持精確計算，而後者則過早地將數學建模與低階實現耦合。我們提出了AMTFV（Agentic Mathematical Tool-Flow Verification）。通過引入數學工具流（MTF）作為中斷--執行--恢復接口，AMTFV將驗證建模與具體執行解耦，並通過數學工具箱支持精確計算。具體而言，驗證代理首先構建驗證工作流程，編碼需要可靠執行的數學對象和計算意圖於MTF請求中，並將其發送給數學工具箱代理。後者解析請求，生成可執行調用，並將其發送到後端進行精確計算。工具輸出隨後支持候選答案裁定、答案修訂和驗證工作流程修訂。我們在五個具有挑戰性的數學推理數據集上評估AMTFV，使用來自DeepSeek、GPT和Gemini的七種模型配置。實驗結果顯示，AMTFV在本研究中整體上優於評估的代表性基準；在單個模型配置下，它將平均準確率提高了最多8.3個百分點，對於中等和高驗證複雜度的樣本增益更大。
